result.question: What plan did more than forty men present to the chief priests and elders?

readings.answer: To have the Sanhedrin ask the commander to bring Paul for a hearing so they could kill him on the way.
readings.support: you and the Sanhedrin petition the commander to bring him down to you on the pretext of examining his case more carefully. We are ready to kill him on the way.
We have bound ourselves with a solemn oath not to eat anything until we have killed Paul.

assessments.reason: It restates the scheme to have the council petition the commander to bring Paul for a supposed examination so they could ambush and kill him on the way, matching v.15.
It captures the core aim of the plan—to kill Paul—cited in v.14, though it omits the pretext and ambush details given in v.15.
